questions.question_text: What is the materiality concept?

options.A: Record all transactions regardless of size
options.B: Only record significant items that affect decisions

questions.question_text: What is the business entity concept?

options.B: Business is separate from its owner
options.C: Owner can use business money freely

questions.question_text: What is the money measurement concept?

options.B: Only record transactions measurable in money

questions.question_text: What is the realization concept?

options.A: Profit is realized when production completes
options.B: Profit is realized when goods are sold
options.C: Profit is realized when cash is received
options.D: Profit is realized when order is placed

questions.question_text: What is the dual aspect concept?

options.B: Every transaction has two equal effects (debit and credit)

questions.question_text: What is accumulated depreciation?

options.B: Total depreciation charged to date on asset

questions.question_text: What is net book value?

options.B: Cost - Accumulated depreciation

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a purchases ledger?

options.B: Record credit purchases from suppliers

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a sales ledger?

options.B: Record credit sales to customers

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a nominal ledger?

options.B: Record all income, expenses, assets and liabilities

questions.question_text: What is the accounting equation after profit?

options.B: Assets = Liabilities + Capital + Profit

questions.question_text: What is drawings in accounting?

options.B: Assets taken by owner for personal use

questions.question_text: What is capital introduced?

options.B: Assets or cash invested by owner

questions.question_text: What is an income statement?

options.B: Statement showing revenue, expenses and profit/loss

questions.question_text: What is a statement of financial position?

options.B: Balance sheet showing assets, liabilities and capital

questions.question_text: What is a trade discount?

options.B: Reduction in list price for bulk purchases

questions.question_text: What is a cash discount?

options.B: Discount for early payment of debts

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a petty cash book?

options.B: Record small cash payments

questions.question_text: What is the imprest system?

options.B: Fixed amount of petty cash replenished when spent

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a statement of cash flows?

options.B: Show sources and uses of cash
